item.title: Petro Matad resumes oil sales
item.summary: Petro Matad said its long-delayed oil sales agreement with PetroChina is finally up and running, allowing it to export a backlog of crude, while its renewable energy venture continues to build a sizeable pipeline of projects in Mongolia. But beyond announcing that oil sales had resumed, there was very little to get excited about in […] The post Petro Matad resumes oil sales appeared first on UK Investor Magazine .
